simple.meaning: חֶצְרוֹנִי (Chetsrôwnîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Chetsronite or (collectively) descendants of Chetsron.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֶצְרוֹנִי (H2697) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 26:6, with occurrences in Numbers.
